Messages.Author: The Corinthian
Messages.Body:
There's an out of turn master card that burns another master card.
My question is, can it burn a master card as it is being played
or can it burn any master card already in play?

A card called Giant's blood restores a vampire to full capacity.
Can this be played on an uncontrolled vampire?



Bin

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
The Corinthian <gt6249c@prism.gatech.edu> wrote:
>There's an out of turn master card that burns another master card.
>My question is, can it burn a master card as it is being played
>or can it burn any master card already in play?

You're thinking of Sudden Reversal.  It can perform either function.

>A card called Giant's blood restores a vampire to full capacity.
>Can this be played on an uncontrolled vampire?

Nothing can interact with uncontrolled vampires unless it specifically
says it can (e.g. Brainwash).  Giant's Blood doesn't say it can be
used on such vampires, so it can't.


Tom Wylie		rec.games.deckmaster Network Representative for
aahz@hal.com			Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
